package.name: bonbon_authority_manager
package.description: Applies config/distributed/failure_policy.yaml to the current bonbon_distributed_safety link states, per-Pi. Produces the AuthoritySnapshot each Pi's own nodes and dashboard consume to know whether motion authority / human interaction is currently available. Never a central arbiter -- each Pi runs its own instance scoped to its own role, matching failure_policy.yaml's each_pi_applies_its_own_loss_policies_independently rule.
